title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan stew made with tender lamb, aromatic spices, and dried fruits.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the prunes and enough water to cover the lamb.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
